title: The site proxy lets the Tracy Business theme's tracy_style cookie through both ways while every other Tracy cookie stays blocked, and the demo address probe uses the deployment's own scheme and port
steps: S1: Run apps/tracy-web/test/site-tracy-cookies.test.mjs: a site behind a Tracy address and behind an own domain answers Set-Cookie tracy_style plus tracy_style_extra, Tracy_Style, tracy_sess, tracy_sess_ab, tracy_shard, __Host-tracy_shard, tracy_handoff, tracy_tok_x, dsh_gateway_token, tracy_new; the browser then sends all of them back. Also send the same cookies on the workspace (dsh) path.

S2: Run apps/tracy-web/test/demo-address-shadowed.test.mjs: bootstrap a demo on a config whose origin is http://cowork.tracy.test:51710 and whose host answers go-live; call demoAddress with a bare config (stand origin, https origin without port) and with a target that states its own scheme and port.
expect: S1: only tracy_style reaches the browser and only tracy_style reaches the site; every other listed cookie is dropped in both directions on both address kinds; the workspace path drops tracy_style too.

S2: the probe goes to http://<label>.tracy.test:51710/__tracy/address-probe and the demo is not failed ADDRESS_SHADOWED; a bare config gives the same address as bornSiteAddress; an https origin without port and a target with its own scheme and port are unchanged.
evidence: QA flows case audit-cms-001-01 expected cookie tracy_style=airbnb after ?style=airbnb and got none; demos bootstrapped on a local stand failed ADDRESS_SHADOWED because the probe asked https without port. The concurrent releases read (23505 on question_set_released) is covered by apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-releases-race.test.mjs, which needs TEST_DATABASE_URL and runs in CI under ci:integration.
fence: isTracyCookieName exempts exactly the case-sensitive name tracy_style and only when called with { site: true }; the tracy_ prefix rule and every other name stay blocked; demoAddress with a bare config returns bornSiteAddress(label, config)

tests: on a Tracy address the theme's tracy_style goes through both ways; every other Tracy name is dropped
on an own domain the theme's tracy_style goes through both ways; every other Tracy name is dropped
dsh is not a site: the workspace path keeps dropping tracy_style
a local stand is probed at its own scheme and port, the address every other site gets
demoAddress: a bare config is the born site address; a target keeps its own scheme and port
